channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Senior Citizen Complains About Voting Problems to Hema Malini in Mumbai
item.description: During the ongoing Maharashtra local polls on Thursday, a senior citizen, who has lived in the area for over 60 years, voiced his frustration over the voting process directly to actress-politician Hema Malini.

item.title: Jay Shah Wishes Young Players as U-19 World Cup Begins
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) chair Jay Shah extended his best wishes to the U19 stars for kickstarting their World Cup campaign in Zimbabwe and Namibia.

item.title: Delhi-NCR shivers as cold wave intensifies; AQI ‘very poor’ in several areas
item.description: The situation in the national capital remains extremely concerning, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) crossing the 350 marks in several areas, placing air quality in the 'very poor' to 'severe' categories.

item.title: Air India, Indigo reroute flights due to Iran airspace closure amid US tensions
item.description: Major Indian airlines Air India, IndiGo, and SpiceJet on Thursday informed of rerouting some of their international flights as Iran shut down its airspace.

item.title: Telangana finalizes reservation in municipal bodies
item.description: Taking a key step for conducting municipal elections in Telangana, the state government has finalised reservation of wards and offices of chairpersons/mayors in 121 municipalities and 10 corporations.

item.title: Gaza reconstruction plan may create openings for Indian firms
item.description: However, the framework being created is similar to post-conflict models where Indian companies have previously worked through international and donor-backed mechanisms.

item.title: Maharashtra votes today in high-stakes polls across 29 civic bodies
item.description: As the state goes to the polls, attention is centred on Mumbai, where the BJP-led MahaYuti is engaged in a closely fought contest with the reunited Thackeray cousins, Raj and Uddhav, for control of the country’s richest civic body.

item.title: Maharashtra Local Polls: Opposition Targets BJP, Slams SEC Over Mismanagement
item.description: Danve, after casting his vote in Sambhajinagar, said, "I received calls until 4.00 a.m. about how the BJP has showered money across this city.

item.title: BRS MLA booked for objectionable remarks against Telangana CM
item.description: Hyderabad Police have registered a case against former minister and BRS MLA T. Srinivas Yadav for making objectionable remarks against Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy.

item.title: Slow Document Verification May Affect West Bengal Final Voter List, Says ECI
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is concerned regarding the slow rate of verification of identification documents provided by "unmapped" voters who have participated in the current hearing sessions concerning the draft voters' list in West Bengal.
